resumen: Chanter and **the benchmark among all recorded players**: 1st in DPS in both raids (62.7k, 38% above average), with 2.7–2.9k support HPS and the best gear (GS 3080, CP 214k). Was in both Rahu kills.
fortalezas: The highest recorded DPS, with 66–70% of hits from behind and 57–59% crit.
The group’s second healer on top of the damage.
In the first run they outlasted the average (first death at 192 s versus 173 s).
mejorar: In the 02:45 run they died more than average (2.33 per attempt versus 2.07).
recomendaciones: Watch 2920718 around 234 s: in the second kill it took out three players in 2 seconds, Posey included.
